newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - March 14.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - March 14.

text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.
- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - Commentary says control of finance risk is neccesary to maintain healthy growth of China's economy.
- Chen Yuan, deputy governor of the People's Bank of China, the central bank, says the aim of China's economic development is to keep inflation lower than the economic growth rate.
- Daye Special Steel Co will issue domestic A shares on the Shenzhen stock exchange on Friday. Northeast Heating and Power Devolpment Co will list A shares in Shanghai on Tuesday.
- BUSINESS NEWS - A poll shows that 70 percent of Chinese comsumers who felt they had been cheated when purchasing products prefer not to make official complaints.
- A total of 80 percent of cars, motorcycles and agricultural vehicles produced in 1996 were bought by individuals, indicating the industry is moving towards becoming a retail market.
